proposals.name: p.offroad_stop_reach
proposals.convention: Off-road stopping reach: the ground distance from a halted vehicle's body to a shoulder within which moving off the main-traveled part counts as practicable; about one lane width of lateral movement.

proposals.name: p.stopping_conflict_gap

proposals.name: p.free_passage_width
proposals.convention: Free-passage width: the smallest width of an unoccupied lane beside a standing vehicle that lets another vehicle pass; a design passenger-car width plus lateral clearance.
proposals.source: AASHTO Green Book design-vehicle widths and lane widths

proposals.name: p.opposite_lane_reach
proposals.convention: Beside reach: the largest ground distance from a standing vehicle's body to a lane within which the lane counts as opposite the vehicle; covers the lateral gap between the body and the next lane's edge.

proposals.name: p.braking_decel_dry
proposals.convention: Braking deceleration on a dry surface: a firm, controlled stop most drivers make on dry pavement.
proposals.source: stopping-distance studies of driver braking on dry pavement (about 0.45 g)

proposals.name: p.braking_decel_ice
proposals.convention: Braking deceleration on an icy or snow-covered surface: the deceleration packed snow or ice allows under controlled braking.
proposals.source: winter-road friction measurements (friction coefficient about 0.15)

proposals.name: p.braking_decel_wet
proposals.convention: Design braking deceleration: the deceleration most drivers keep within their lane and control on a wet surface, used by the stopping sight distance model.
proposals.source: AASHTO Green Book, stopping sight distance (deceleration rate)

proposals.name: p.curve_lateral_accel
proposals.convention: Curve lateral acceleration: the lateral acceleration (speed squared times curvature) above which a curve is taken faster than ordinary drivers' comfort and control margin.
proposals.source: side-friction and driver-comfort studies of curve negotiation

proposals.name: p.lateral_margin_time
proposals.convention: Speed-proportional lateral margin: the lateral room beside a vehicle, both sides together, that grows with speed to absorb lateral wander; the speed times this time must fit in the lane width beyond the vehicle's width.
proposals.source: lane-width and lateral-clearance studies of speed choice

proposals.name: p.perception_reaction_time
proposals.convention: Perception-reaction time: the time a driver keeps its speed before braking begins, in the stopping sight distance model.
proposals.source: AASHTO Green Book, stopping sight distance (brake reaction time)

proposals.name: p.traffic_time_headway
proposals.convention: Minimum time headway in traffic: the time gap to the road user ahead in the lane below which the speed is too high for the traffic.
proposals.source: car-following headway conventions
